clock.why: the 2.4 GHz radio runs from a 32 MHz HSE crystal (AN5165)

board.reason: a bare WB55 needs RF design (matching network, antenna) and its SMPS inductor and 32 MHz crystal; use a module (STM32WB5MMG) for a board. Firmware, pins and chip choice work.

currents.source: DS11929 Rev 14 (STM32WB55xx): run 64 MHz with SMPS 5.00 mA (8.15 mA on LDO) at 3.3 V (Table 37); Stop 2 with RTC on LSE 2.45 µA (Table 43); BLE 0 dBm with SMPS TX 5.2 mA, RX 4.5 mA (Table 30). No minimum supply current stated; 30 mA is Bringup's margin

history.source: STM32duino EEPROM emulation: one 4 KB flash page (RM0434 §3.3)

sim.note: Renode 1.17 models the STM32WBA52, not the WB55

sources: DS11929 Rev 14: Fig. 16 power supply (VDD n × 100 nF + 4.7 µF; VDDA 10 nF + 1 µF; VDDRF 100 nF + 100 pF; VDDSMPS/VFBSMPS 4.7 µF), Table 6 SMPS inductor 2.2 µH or 10 µH + 10 nH, §3.6 32 MHz HSE mandatory for RF
STM32duino nucleo_wb55rg_p is the 68-pin package: a 48-pin board needs its own variant
